theater: 河東、河北與山東游擊區

battle.name: 紅襖軍抗金起義
battle.theater: 河東、河北與山東游擊區
battle.brief: 金宣宗貞祐元年冬，蒙古軍南下、河北山東連遭兵燹，金廷又括地括丁，劉六符、劉八遂於河東聚眾起事，以紅色短襖為號，紅襖軍由此得名。起義以鄉兵游擊、破堡焚倉為主，攻城只靠撞木、雲梯與火攻；卡面這件配重投石車並未出現在這條戰線，倒是蒙古軍同期帶入的配重砲與火器，才是當時攻城技術的分水嶺。

kit.name: 配重投石車
kit.history: 長臂配重把石頭甩過城牆。工程比攻城武器更早決定勝負。

countries: 交戰的一方是金朝（女真完顏氏）的中都朝廷。貞祐年間北方的實權分歸行台尚書省與各路統軍司，河北、山東的防務由屯田軍與新編漢軍分擔；女真猛安謀克屯田戶是兵制骨幹，輔以被強行簽發的漢軍與鄉兵，蒙古南下之後括丁、括地愈演愈烈，縣鎮多築堡寨自守。交戰的另一方並非國家，而是起於民眾的武裝起義隊伍：劉六符、劉八首舉於河東，楊安、趙進、張喜、李全等在河北、山東分頭聚眾，首領多出自漁戶、獵戶、亡命與潰散士卒，號召對象是失去土地的佃客、逃丁與流民，組織依渠帥、隊主層層分幫，紅色短襖與紅巾是共同標誌。此外還有蒙古東路軍：成吉思汗親統中軍，木華黎率右翼自遼東入燕雲，它既是紅襖軍得以壯大的外部壓力，也在部分時段與其遙相呼應；木華黎招降的漢人將領張柔、郝和尚所部漢軍，則是介於兩者之間的第三種力量。指揮系統上，金廷前期主剿，中期改以招討司、安撫司名義招撫首領、授官給糧，把部分紅襖軍武裝改編為官軍；南宋則在其後招納北方義軍，設忠義軍名目收編河北山東的流民武裝。
countriesEn: One side of the conflict was the Zhongdu court of the Jin dynasty, founded by the Jurchen Wanyan clan. During the Zhenyou era the real power in the north was divided between the provisional secretariat and the regional military commissions, and the defence of Hebei and Shandong was shared between the Jurchen farming garrisons and newly mustered Han troops. The Jurchen meng'an mouke farm households formed the backbone of the military system, supported by Han soldiers and village militia seized by impressment; after the Mongol advance south the impressment of labour and the seizure of land grew worse every year, and the county towns built fortified villages to protect themselves. The other side was not a state but a popular armed movement: Liu Liufu and Liu Ba raised the first banner in Hedong, and Yang An, Zhao Jin, Zhang Xi and Li Quan gathered their bands separately across Hebei and Shandong. Most of the leaders were fishermen, hunters, outlaws and scattered soldiers, and their appeal was aimed at tenant farmers who had lost their land, at men who had fled the impressment and at vagrants. The organisation ran in layers of band leaders and captains, and a short red jacket with a red kerchief was the common badge. A third force was the Mongol eastern army: Genghis Khan led the centre himself while Muqali took the right wing through Liaodong into the Yanyun region; it was the external pressure that allowed the Red Coat bands to grow, and for part of the time the two loosely cooperated. The Han Chinese commanders Muqali recruited, Zhang Rou and Hao Heshang among them, formed a third power standing between the two. On the command side the Jin court began with suppression, then in the middle period changed to using the titles of military commission and pacification office to pardon the leaders, to grant rank and grain, and to turn part of the Red Coat forces into regular troops. The Southern Song later drew in the northern insurgents as well, registering the refugee bands of Hebei and Shandong under the name of the loyal righteous army.
people: 核心人物是河北、河東起兵的劉六符與其弟劉八。劉六符是邢州人，貞祐元年冬在河東聚眾起事，因眾皆衣紅色短襖而得紅襖軍之名，兄弟二人隨後在河北南部與山東轉戰，劉六符於一二一三年前後在金軍追剿中陣亡，紅襖軍隨之分裂為數支。河北與山東方面的首領有楊安、趙進、張喜：楊安長期活動於山東，曾率眾攻取兗、鄆一帶的縣鎮；趙進據地河北，屢次襲擊金軍糧道；張喜在山東樹旗最久，受金廷招撫的時候眾至數萬，是招撫政策的主要對象。楚州一路的人物是李全，他出身山東紅襖軍，先在魯南聚眾，後率部南下，據楚州（今江蘇淮安）招納流民，勢力伸入兩淮；其弟李璮於一二三二年在益都以紅襖軍舊部起兵反金，是這場運動餘波中最後一次大規模爆發。金廷方面的關鍵人物是金宣宗完顏允恭與繼位的金哀宗完顏宗仁：宣宗在蒙古壓力下南遷汴京，哀宗面對北方州縣盡失、義軍此起彼伏的局面，改採招撫與以漢治漢的策略。蒙古方面，木華黎是自遼東南下一路的主將，他一面進攻中都與河北山東，一面招降北方漢人武裝，張柔、郝和尚等相繼歸附。南宋方面，李全等部眾南下後先後為宋所用，後又與蒙古往來，牽動兩淮戰局數十年。
peopleEn: The central figures are Liu Liufu of Hebei and Hedong and his younger brother Liu Ba. Liu Liufu was a man of Xingzhou, and in the winter of the first year of Zhenyou he gathered a following in Hedong and rose in revolt; because the crowd all wore short red jackets the movement took the name of the Red Coat army. The two brothers then fought their way through southern Hebei and Shandong, and Liu Liufu was killed by Jin troops in the course of the pursuit around 1213, after which the Red Coat movement broke up into several separate bands. The leaders in Hebei and Shandong were Yang An, Zhao Jin and Zhang Xi. Yang An operated for a long time in Shandong and led his men against the county towns of the Yanzhou and Yunzhou area; Zhao Jin held ground in Hebei and repeatedly struck the Jin supply lines; Zhang Xi raised his banner in Shandong for the longest time and, when the Jin court came to pardon him, had tens of thousands under him, which made him the main target of the policy of conciliation. The figure on the Chu prefecture road was Li Quan. He came out of the Shandong Red Coat bands, first gathering a following in southern Lu, then leading his men south to occupy Chu prefecture, present-day Huai'an in Jiangsu, where he took in vagrants and built a power reaching into the Huai region. His younger brother Li Tan rose in Yidu in 1232 with the old Red Coat troops and rebelled against the Jin; that was the last large outbreak in the aftershock of this movement. On the Jin side the decisive figures were the Jin Xuanzong Wanyan Yungong and his successor the Jin Aizong Wanyang Zongren. Xuanzong moved the capital south to Bianjing under Mongol pressure, and Aizong, confronted with the loss of the northern prefectures and with insurgents rising on every side, turned to conciliation and to the principle of governing the Han with Han. On the Mongol side Muqali commanded the army that came down through Liaodong; he attacked Zhongdu, Hebei and Shandong on one front and on the other recruited the northern Han armed bands, and Zhang Rou and Hao Heshang came over to him one after another. On the Southern Song side the troops that came south with Li Quan were used by the Song first and afterwards dealt with the Mongols, and they kept the war in the Huai region unsettled for decades.
kits: 卡面這件配重投石車，設計年份定在一一〇〇年，正落在歐洲把配重機理用成熟的十字軍時代：十二世紀末圍攻阿克的攻城戰中已見其蹟跡，拋出的石彈能越過城牆砸碎塔樓與屋頂，攻城方因此得以用遠程火力壓制守軍，而不必把木塔與撞車送到牆下。配重砲的起源究竟在東亞、伊斯蘭世界還是歐洲，學界至今仍在爭論，但可以確定的是它在十三世紀已隨十字軍東征與商路東進進入中亞，蒙古人西征時又把中亞的工程人員與器械帶回東方。紅襖軍自身幾乎沒有重型攻城裝備：他們的攻城手段是夜襲、內應、雲梯、撞木與火把，武器以劫自官府的弓弩、刀槍為主，農具改製的叉、鎗、鋤大量充當步戰兵器，衣著是粗麻短襖與皮製護胸，北方馬匹使他們能夠快速轉戰。金軍與蒙古軍的裝備體系是另一個層次：女真重騎以鐵札甲與弓射為主，蒙古攻城序列裡配著配重砲與火器，一二二六年攻潼關、一三二年前後的蔡州之役，以配重砲拋擲石塊與火球破城已有明確記載，這正是配重投石車這條技術線在東亞的成熟形態；而紅襖軍靠的仍是木石與火柴。
kitsEn: The piece on the card, the counterweight trebuchet, is dated to the year 1100, which places it exactly in the age of the Crusades when Europe was making the counterweight principle work: the siege of Acre at the end of the twelfth century already shows its traces, the stone it threw could pass over the wall and smash towers and roofs, and the besiegers could therefore hold the defenders down with long range fire instead of carrying wooden towers and rams up to the wall. Whether the counterweight engine originated in East Asia, in the Islamic world or in Europe is still argued over by scholars, but what can be settled is that by the thirteenth century it had travelled east with the Crusades and the trading roads into Central Asia, and that the Mongols brought the engineers and the machines of Central Asia back with them from the west. The Red Coat army itself had almost no heavy siege equipment: their methods of assault were night attacks, insiders, scaling ladders, rams and firebrands, and their weapons were bows and crossbows taken from government stores together with spears and swords, while farm tools converted into forks, halberds and mattocks filled the ranks of the foot soldiers. Their clothing was coarse hemp short jackets and leather body armour, and the horses of the north allowed them to shift their ground quickly. The equipment system of the Jin and Mongol armies belonged to a different level entirely: the heavy Jurchen cavalry relied on iron lamellar armour and the bow, and the Mongol siege train was furnished with counterweight engines and gunpowder weapons. At the attack on Tongguan in 1226 and at the siege of Caizhou around 1232 there is clear record of the counterweight engine throwing stones and fireballs to breach the wall, and that is the mature form this line of technology took in East Asia. The Red Coat bands, for their part, still relied on timber, stone and firebrands.
tactics: 紅襖軍的戰法以流動的鄉兵游擊為骨幹。起事初期，眾多聚集在村社、山寨與寺觀之中，乘金軍主力被蒙古牽制、州縣守備空虛之際夜襲城邑：破堡寨用撞木撞門或以火把焚燒外牆，內應在城中開門接應；入城之後的第一件事是打開官倉，把糧食分給饑民，並燒毀屯田軍的籍帳與括地文契，這一招直接動搖了金廷在河北山東的稅基與丁源。馬隊是機動骨幹，白晝在村落與林地中休息，夜間奔馳數十里外襲擊，敵騎一到即據寨牆、拒馬與壕溝以弩箭齊射，待金騎逼近柵下才以步卒出寨分割。游擊隊還刻意破壞驛道、糧道與黃河渡口，使金軍的調動與運輸遲滯，並在金軍與蒙古軍交戰時從側後襲擊其營壘，迫其分兵。與蒙古的關係始終是利用而非同盟：兩軍都盯著金朝的城池與糧源，卻互不信任，紅襖軍也曾趁蒙古軍收兵掠地時奪取對方的屯糧。金廷的處置分兩段：前期以女真騎兵與新編漢軍逐堡掃清，意在斬首不留；後期改為在要地設招討司、授官、給糧、許其自署部曲，把不肯就範者孤立起來逐一攻滅。紅襖軍在這一步分化最為殘酷：受撫者成為金朝討平蒙古的工具，未受撫者或戰死、或北走降蒙、或率眾南下另尋生路。
tacticsEn: The method of the Red Coat bands had the mobile village footmen for its backbone. At the outset the crowds gathered in village communities, mountain strongholds and monasteries, and they struck the walled towns by night while the Jin main force was being held by the Mongols and the county seats were short of garrisons. To break a fortified village they rammed the gates with a beam or set fire to the outer wall, while insiders inside opened the gates for them. The first thing they did after entering a city was to open the government granaries, distribute the grain to the hungry and burn the registers of the farming garrisons together with the title deeds that recorded the seizure of land, and that single act struck straight at the tax base and the source of corvée labour that the Jin court drew in Hebei and Shandong. The mounted men were the arm of movement: they rested by day in villages and woods and rode out at night to strike dozens of li away, and when the enemy horse came up they would man the village wall, the caltrops and the ditch and loose a volley of crossbow bolts, only bringing the footmen out to cut up the Jin horse when it was pressed against the fence. The bands deliberately destroyed the post roads, the grain roads and the crossings of the Yellow River so as to slow the movement and the transport of the Jin army, and they would fall on the Jin camp from the rear while that army was engaged with the Mongols, forcing it to divide. The relationship with the Mongols was one of use and not of alliance: both armies were after the cities and the grain of the Jin, yet they did not trust each other, and the Red Coat bands even seized Mongol stores when the Mongol army drew off with its plunder. The Jin court's response came in two stages. In the first it swept the fortified villages one by one with Jurchen horse and newly raised Han troops, intent on leaving no leader alive. In the second it set up military commissions at the key points, granted rank, issued grain, allowed the bands to enrol their own men, and picked off those who would not come to terms one after another. This was the cruellest turning point for the Red Coat army: those who were pardoned became an instrument of the Jin for fighting the Mongols, while those who were not either died in the field, or went north to the Mongols, or led their men south in search of another living.
data: 可核的時間點相當清楚。起事在金宣宗貞祐元年，即一二一一年，時值成吉思汗大軍越陰山南下、木華黎率右翼自遼東入燕雲；一二一三年蒙古再大舉進攻河北，一二一四年金宣宗遷都汴京，一二一五年蒙古軍攻陷中都。紅襖軍最盛的階段是起事後的三五年，主要在河東、河北與山東三地活動，佔地最遠曾及滄州與山東中部。兵員數字要打折扣看：金廷奏報與地方志書常寫紅襖軍有眾數十萬乃至百餘萬，實際能作戰的骨幹每支不過數千至數萬，多為步卒而少騎兵，跨區作戰更受馬匹與糧食限制。距離方面，起兵地邢州至山東重鎮濟南依當時驛路約五百里，河北南部一帶的堡寨多在百餘里內互相呼應，義軍的活動半徑大致以一縣至三四縣為一圈。損失與俘獲數量沒有可靠記載，金廷只記各城「陷」與「殲敵若干」，多屬宣示性文字；能確定的只是雙方在河北山東拉鋸數年，縣鎮的城牆、倉廩與屯田水利反覆被毀。攻城技術的數字見於另一條戰線：配重砲在華北的成熟戰例是一二二六年潼關與一二三二年蔡州之役。
dataEn: The verifiable points in time are fairly clear. The rising began in the first year of Zhenyou of the Jin Xuanzong, that is in 1211, at the moment when Genghis Khan's main army crossed the Yinshan mountains and Muqali led the right wing through Liaodong into the Yanyun region. The Mongols invaded Hebei on a great scale once more in 1213, the Jin Xuanzong moved the capital to Bianjing in 1214, and the Mongol army took Zhongdu in 1215. The Red Coat movement was at its height in the three to five years after the rising, operating mainly in the three regions of Hedong, Hebei and Shandong and reaching as far as Cangzhou and the middle of Shandong. The numbers of men have to be taken with a discount: memorials of the Jin court and the local gazetteers habitually speak of tens of thousands and even of more than a hundred thousand, but the actual fighting core of each band was only some thousands to a few tens of thousands, foot soldiers for the most part with few horsemen, and movement between regions was limited further by horses and grain. As for distances, from the place of the rising at Xingzhou to the Shandong stronghold of Jinan was about five hundred li by the post roads of the time, and the fortified villages of southern Hebei answered one another within a little more than a hundred li; the radius of the insurgents' operations was roughly a single county or three or four. There is no reliable record of losses or captures, for the Jin court merely notes that a city 'fell' and that so many enemies were 'destroyed', which is largely declaratory language; what can be settled is only that the two sides dragged on for years in Hebei and Shandong and the walls, granaries and irrigation works of the county towns were destroyed again and again. The figures on siege technique belong to another front: the mature trials of the counterweight engine in North China are the attack on Tongguan in 1226 and the siege of Caizhou in 1232.
cause: 起義的直接背景，是金朝對河北山東竭澤而魚式的治理。北宋傾覆之後，北方州縣殘破、戶口銳減，金廷一面以女真屯田軍分佔漢地良田，一面在蒙古壓力下屢加括地，把已由國家授田的漢民土地強行收作牧場，隨之而來的是括丁、增賦與折色加派，漢地農戶既失地又失子。蒙古入侵把這套體系的負擔推到極限：一二一一年起蒙古大軍南下，河北山東州縣屢陷，擄掠與屠殺相隨；蒙古要維持騎兵戰力，又逼金廷供應草料與牧地，括地的範圍與強度隨之擴大，紅襖軍所謂的抗金，矛頭其實首先指向收地、催丁與屯田的官府。號召因此十分直接：守住自己的地、自己的糧倉與自己的鄉里，趕走括地的女真屯田戶與催丁的官吏。抗金之外，民間也帶著靖康之變以來漢人對女真統治的怨恨，以及對金廷南遷、北方州縣淪為蒙古騎兵獵場的恐懼。這種以鄉里自保為名的武裝，一旦遇上蒙古造成的軍政真空，便能迅速擴張為跨州縣的起義。
causeEn: The immediate background of the rising was the Jin court's strip-mining governance of Hebei and Shandong. After the fall of the Northern Song the northern prefectures lay ruined and the population was thin, and the court on the one hand quartered Jurchen farming garrisons on the good land of the Han districts, and on the other hand repeatedly seized land as Mongol pressure mounted, taking for the pastures fields that the state itself had granted to Han farmers. What followed was the impressment of labour, increased levies and the shifting of taxes into other forms of payment, so that the Han peasants of the north lost both their land and their sons. The Mongol invasion pushed the weight of this system to the limit: from 1211 the Mongol armies came south, the prefectures of Hebei and Shandong fell one after another, and capture and killing went with it. The Mongols needed fodder and pasture to keep their cavalry in the field and forced the Jin to supply it, so the reach and the severity of the land seizures widened as the years went on, and the anti-Jin cry of the Red Coat bands was in reality directed first at the officials who took the land, drove the labour and ran the farming garrisons. Their appeal was therefore entirely direct: hold on to your own fields, your own granaries and your own villages, and drive out the Jurchen farming households who had taken the land and the officials who drove the men. Over and above the war against the Jin there lay the resentment the Han people had carried since the Disaster of Jingkang against Jurchen rule, and the fear that with the Jin court running south the northern prefectures would become hunting grounds for Mongol horsemen. An armed movement calling itself defence of the home village, once it met the military and administrative vacuum the Mongols had created, could spread at once into an insurrection across several prefectures.
impact: 紅襖軍是金元之際第一次出現的大規模漢人自發抗金武裝，它在北方留下的東西比它在戰場上取得的戰果更多。首先，它證明了金廷在河北山東的括地、括丁政策已無力維持，迫使金朝在數年內改弦更張，由逐堡掃清轉為設招討司、授官給糧，把地方武裝收編為官軍；金朝此後倚重的北方武力，很大程度上就是這批被招撫的紅襖軍。其次，它開啟了南宋招納北方義軍的路子：紅襖軍餘部與其後繼者南下兩淮，被南宋以忠義軍名義收編，成為宋、金、蒙三方角力的棋子，李全家族在楚州與海州一帶的割據，長久影響著兩淮防務，直到蒙古攻取楚州前後才告結束。第三，它加速了金朝的崩解：北方州縣在蒙古與紅襖軍的雙重壓力下相繼脫離金廷，金的北方領土被啃得只剩河南一路，兩淮與山東這道緩衝地帶消失。第四，它為蒙古滅金掃清了內部障礙，也把北方漢人武裝化的傳統留給了此後的宋金對峙。第五，作為民間記憶，紅襖軍在宋元以降的說部與雜記中多被寫成北方義軍的源頭，它的紅襖意象後來被戲曲與年畫反覆借用。
impactEn: The Red Coat army was the first large spontaneous Han rising against the Jin in the transition between Jin and Yuan, and what it left behind in the north was worth more than what it won on the field. In the first place it showed that the policies of seizing land and impressing labour could no longer be maintained in Hebei and Shandong, and it forced the Jin within a few years to change course, moving from the sweep of one fortified village to the next towards setting up military commissions, granting rank and issuing grain and folding the local armed bands into the regular army; the northern military strength the Jin came to rely on afterwards was to a large extent these pardoned Red Coat bands. In the second place it opened the road by which the Southern Song drew in the northern insurgents: the remnants of the Red Coat army and their successors moved south into the Huai region and were taken into Song service under the name of the loyal righteous army, becoming pieces in the triangular struggle of Song, Jin and Mongol, and the separatism of the Li Quan family around Chu prefecture and Haizhou governed the defence of the Huai for a long time, only ending around the time the Mongols took Chu prefecture. In the third place it hastened the dissolution of the Jin: the northern prefectures slipped away from the Jin court under the double pressure of the Mongols and the Red Coat bands, the Jin territories in the north were eaten back until only the Henan road remained, and the buffer zone of the Huai and Shandong disappeared. In the fourth place it cleared the internal obstacle to the Mongol destruction of the Jin, and left behind the tradition of the armed Han of the north for the Song-Jin confrontation that followed. In the fifth place, in popular memory, the Red Coat army is written into the storytelling and miscellanies of the Song, Yuan and later as the fountainhead of the northern righteous armies, and its image of the red jacket was borrowed again and again by the theatre and the New Year pictures.
result: 起義自一二一一年冬發動，至一二一五年前後達到最盛：劉六符、劉八在河東首義，楊安、趙進、張喜、李全等在河北山東各擁重兵，攻破沿途縣鎮與堡寨，焚官倉、散糧於民，並在金軍與蒙古軍交戰時游走於兩軍之間，令金廷疲於奔命。金廷的轉變出現在起義後第四五年：一二一八年以後改行招撫，授部分首領節度使、招討使之類名號並按例給糧，受撫者停止攻擊，未受撫者被集中兵力逐一殲滅，趙進、楊安等相繼兵敗身死，紅襖軍作為統一運動至此崩解，只餘散兵四散。剩下的火種並未熄滅：一部分留在山東河北與蒙古為伍，一部分隨李全南下楚州，在兩淮成為南宋倚重而又提防的武裝；最醒目的一次餘波是一二三二年李璮在益都以舊部起兵反金，兵敗身亡，紅襖軍從此再無成建制的大動作，只餘零星抗金小股。金朝北方因此更加空虛，一二二〇年代蒙古得以長驅南下，一二二七年再取河東山西，一二三四年金亡。
resultEn: The rising was launched in the winter of 1211 and reached its height around 1215: Liu Liufu and Liu Ba raised the first banner in Hedong, while Yang An, Zhao Jin, Zhang Xi and Li Quan each raised several thousand men in Hebei and Shandong, carried the county towns and fortified villages along their route, fired the government granaries and scattered the grain among the people, and moved about between the Jin and Mongol armies while those two were fighting, leaving the Jin court worn out. The turn in the court's policy came in the fourth or fifth year after the rising: after 1218 conciliation replaced annihilation, some of the leaders were granted titles such as military commissioner or pacification commissioner and were given grain according to the regulations, those who accepted stopped attacking, and those who did not were picked off one by one by concentrated force, with Zhao Jin and Yang An among them dying in battle. The Red Coat army as a single movement came apart at that point, and only scattered bands remained. The embers did not go out: some stayed in Shandong and Hebei and joined the Mongols, and some followed Li Quan south to Chu prefecture, becoming in the Huai region an armed force the Southern Song both relied on and watched; the most conspicuous aftershock was Li Tan's rising in Yidu in 1232 with the old bands against the Jin, defeated and killed, and after that the Red Coat army never mounted another large operation in formation, only scattered bands of a few against the Jin. The north of the Jin court grew emptier as a result, the Mongols were able to drive deep south in the 1220s, took Hedong and Shanxi again in 1227, and the Jin fell in 1234.
